title: CLAUDE.md – oddsapiR Development Guide
text: requests go shared helpers utils.R. Never call httr2/httr directly wrapper. Wrappers build base URL + named query list hand toa_api_call(): toa_api_call(url, query) – builds request, performs , returns parsed JSON. toa_api_headers(url, query) – , returns requests_remaining/requests_used quota data.frame (used toa_requests()). NULL query values dropped automatically httr2::req_url_query(), optional parameters (bookmakers = NULL, event_ids = NULL, days_from = NULL) can threaded unconditionally – never build query list conditionally. Booleans must lowercased strings: includeRotationNumbers = (isTRUE(x)) "true" else NULL.
code: toa_function <- function(sport_key, regions = 'us', markets = 'h2h', date_format = 'iso'){   base_url <- glue::glue('https://api.the-odds-api.com/v4/sports/{sport_key}/odds')   query_params <- list(     apiKey      = as.character(toa_key()),     regions     = regions,     markets     = markets,     dateFormat  = date_format   )    odds <- data.frame()   # initialize return var BEFORE tryCatch (see below)    tryCatch(     expr = {       odds <- toa_api_call(base_url, query = query_params) %>%         # ... parse ...         make_toa_data("Sports Odds data from the-odds-api.com", Sys.time())     },     error = function(e) {       cli::cli_alert_danger("{Sys.time()}: Invalid arguments or no data available for {sport_key}!")       cli::cli_alert_danger("Error:\n{e}")     },     warning = function(w) {       cli::cli_alert_warning("{Sys.time()}: Warning:\n{w}")     },     finally = {}   )   return(odds) }

title: CLAUDE.md – oddsapiR Development Guide
text: Every wrapper assigns return variable inside tryCatch returns unconditionally. Initialize variable empty value (data.frame()) tryCatch, otherwise API error leaves variable unbound return(<var>) throws object '<var>' found instead intended cli message + empty fallback. applies every return name (odds, events, scores, participants, etc.).

title: CLAUDE.md – oddsapiR Development Guide
text: Odds API returns three usage headers every response: x-requests-remaining, x-requests-used, x-requests-last. toa_api_request() caches package-local .oddsapiR environment via .toa_store_quota(). : Attached attributes (oddsapiR_requests_remaining/_used/_last) every returned tibble make_toa_data() (dplyr/tidyr transforms strip attributes intermediate parse, attached end, raw response). Echoed oddsapiR_data tibble printed (print.oddsapiR_data). Exposed via exported toa_quota() accessor (last call’s usage session). adding wrapper, nothing special – routing toa_api_call() + make_toa_data() wires quota capture automatically.

title: CLAUDE.md – oddsapiR Development Guide
text: Odds payloads nest bookmakers[] -> markets[] -> outcomes[]. Unnest long tibble rename ambiguous key/last_update fields level: single-event endpoints response one object; build 1-row tibble bookmakers = list(raw$bookmakers) list-column (requires tibble::tibble) unnesting. Historical endpoints wrap payload {timestamp, previous_timestamp, next_timestamp, data} envelope – surface three snapshot timestamps leading columns (.= 1). make_toa_data() sets class c("oddsapiR_data","tbl_df","tbl","data.table","data.frame") attaches oddsapiR_timestamp / oddsapiR_type / quota attributes.

text: oddsapiR follows conventions documented CLAUDE.md. essentials: Naming. Public functions prefixed toa_ mirror endpoint shape. HTTP layer. Never call httr2 directly. Build base URL + named query_params list call toa_api_call(base_url, query = query_params). NULL query values dropped automatically, thread optional parameters unconditionally. Initialize return variable (e.g. odds <- data.frame()) tryCatch API error returns empty tibble instead erroring unbound name. Include Usage quota cost note @description. Messaging uses cli::cli_alert_*, bare message().

code: #' @name toa_resource #' @title **Get <thing> from The Odds API** #' @description #' **<one-line description>.** #' #' **Usage quota cost:** <Free | markets × regions | 1 | 10 × markets × regions>. #' @param sport_key (*string*, required): The `sport_key`. See [toa_sports()]. #' @param regions (*string*, required): Comma-delimited regions (`us`, `us2`, `uk`, `eu`, `au`). #' @return A tibble with one row per <unit>: #' #'    |col_name  |types     |description                         | #'    |:---------|:---------|:-----------------------------------| #'    |id        |character |Unique event id.                    | #'    |sport_key |character |Sport key, e.g. `basketball_nba`.   | #' #' @keywords Betting Lines #' @importFrom cli cli_alert_danger #' @importFrom glue glue #' @importFrom dplyr rename #' @importFrom rlang .data #' @import tidyr #' @export #' @examples \donttest{ #'    try(toa_resource(sport_key = 'basketball_nba', regions = 'us')) #' } toa_resource <- function(sport_key, regions = 'us', date_format = 'iso'){   base_url <- glue::glue('https://api.the-odds-api.com/v4/sports/{sport_key}/resource')   query_params <- list(     apiKey     = as.character(toa_key()),     regions    = regions,     dateFormat = date_format   )    resource <- data.frame()   # MANDATORY: initialize before tryCatch    tryCatch(     expr = {       resource <- toa_api_call(base_url, query = query_params) %>%         # parse: unnest bookmakers -> markets -> outcomes, rename key/last_update         make_toa_data("Resource data from the-odds-api.com", Sys.time())     },     error = function(e) {       cli::cli_alert_danger("{Sys.time()}: Invalid arguments or no data available for {sport_key}!")       cli::cli_alert_danger("Error:\n{e}")     },     warning = function(w) {       cli::cli_alert_warning("{Sys.time()}: Warning:\n{w}")     },     finally = {}   )   return(resource) }

what: Inspect your Odds API usage quota — toa_quota
title: Inspect your Odds API usage quota — toa_quota
text: Returns usage-quota headers reported Odds API recent toa_*() call made R session. Odds API returns three headers every response: x-requests-remaining – usage credits remaining quota resets x-requests-used – usage credits used since last quota reset x-requests-last – usage cost last API call values attached attributes (oddsapiR_requests_remaining, oddsapiR_requests_used, oddsapiR_requests_last) every tibble returned toa_*() function, echoed tibble printed.

what: Find historical featured-market odds through the Odds API — toa_sports_odds_history
title: Find historical featured-market odds through the Odds API — toa_sports_odds_history
text: Get historical featured-market odds sport Odds API covers. Returns list events featured bookmaker odds (h2h, spreads, totals) appeared snapshot closest () requested date. response wrapped snapshot envelope; returned timestamp, previous_timestamp next_timestamp columns let page backward/forward time. endpoint previously /v4/sports/{sport}/odds-history, deprecated favour /v4/historical/sports/{sport}/odds. Historical data available paid usage plans June 2020. Usage quota cost: 10 x [number markets] x [number regions]. Snapshots events count quota.

title: Find historical featured-market odds through the Odds API — toa_sports_odds_history
code: toa_sports_odds_history(   sport_key,   date,   regions = "us",   markets = "spreads",   odds_format = "decimal",   date_format = "iso",   event_ids = NULL,   bookmakers = NULL )

title: Find historical featured-market odds through the Odds API — toa_sports_odds_history
text: sport_key (string, required): sport_key look odds . See toa_sports() full lookup sport_key values. date (string, required): timestamp data snapshot return, ISO 8601 format (e.g. 2023-03-18T12:15:00Z). API returns closest snapshot equal earlier value. regions (string, required): region(s) pull bookmakers . Multiple can specified comma delimited. Options include: us us2 uk eu au markets (string, optional): featured markets return. Multiple can specified comma delimited. Options include h2h, spreads, totals. odds_format (string, optional): Format return odds. Options decimal (default) american. date_format (string, optional): Format returned timestamps. Options iso (default) unix. event_ids (string, optional): Comma-separated list event ids filter snapshot . Defaults NULL (events). bookmakers (string, optional): Comma-separated list bookmakers returned. bookmakers regions specified, bookmakers takes precedence. Every group 10 bookmakers counts 1 region usage quota.

title: oddsapiR 1.0.0
text: First major release. Full coverage Odds API v4, httr2 HTTP stack, per-request usage-quota reporting.

title: oddsapiR 1.0.0
text: toa_sports_events() – -play upcoming events sport (/v4/sports/{sport}/events). toa_event_markets() – available market keys per bookmaker single event (/v4/sports/{sport}/events/{eventId}/markets). toa_sports_participants() – teams players sport (/v4/sports/{sport}/participants). toa_sports_events_history() – historical events snapshot (/v4/historical/sports/{sport}/events). toa_event_odds_history() – historical single-event odds (/v4/historical/sports/{sport}/events/{eventId}/odds). toa_quota() – new exported accessor returning usage credits (requests_remaining, requests_used, requests_last) recent call. values attached attributes every returned tibble echoed oddsapiR_data object printed. Every wrapper’s @return documentation now 3-column table (col_name | types | description) carries Usage quota cost note.

title: oddsapiR 1.0.0
text: HTTP stack migrated httr httr2. httr janitor removed Imports; tibble promoted Imports. toa_sports_odds_history() now calls current /v4/historical/sports/{sport}/odds endpoint (legacy /v4/sports/{sport}/odds-history path deprecated upstream). signature changed: date now required second argument event_ids optional filter. return gains leading timestamp, previous_timestamp next_timestamp columns.

title: oddsapiR 1.0.0
text: Wrappers now initialize return variable tryCatch, API error (500/timeout/connection reset) returns empty tibble cli message instead throwing object '...' found. toa_event_odds() parsing robust (builds explicit tibble rather as_tibble(data = ".")) surfaces outcomes_description player-prop markets. Returns self-describing: toa_sports_participants() echoes sport_key, historical wrappers surface snapshot timestamps.

title: oddsapiR 1.0.0
text: Tests added new functions; legacy tests hardened gate has_toa_key(), skip empty/--season responses, assert columns subset-direction (expect_in(sort(cols), sort(colnames(x)))) upstream column additions don’t break suite.
